transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad to meet you today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely anxious and distressed after a traumatic event that happened about three weeks ago. I just can't seem to move past it, and it's constantly on my mind.
To help me understand what you're going through, could you share a little bit about what happened three weeks ago?

Something really awful happened to me about three weeks ago. I'm sorry, but it is just too painful and difficult for me to talk about the details of the event right now. It still feels too fresh and overwhelming to put into words.

I completely understand, and we don't have to go into details about the event. Since it happened, have you been experiencing unwanted memories, nightmares, or sudden feelings as if you are reliving it?

Yes, absolutely. I keep getting these awful, unwanted memories popping into my head during the day, and my sleep is ruined by terrible nightmares about it. Sometimes, I even have moments where I freeze because it feels like I'm reliving the whole thing all over again.
Have you found yourself trying hard to avoid thoughts, feelings, or conversations about what happened, or staying away from places and people that remind you of it?
I haven't really been trying to avoid thinking or talking about it. I'm not sure if I've been actively avoiding reminders, it's more that the memories and feelings just force their way in anyway.
Have you noticed feeling constantly on guard, easily startled, or having trouble concentrating and sleeping since the event?

Yes, I definitely feel constantly on guard. I find myself always scanning my surroundings for potential danger, checking where the exits are, and I just can't seem to relax even when I'm in a safe place.
Have you experienced any feelings of detachment from yourself or your surroundings, as if you're in a dream or things around you aren't real?
No, I haven't really experienced that kind of detachment. I don't feel like I'm in a dream or that the things around me aren't real.
Since the event, have you found it difficult to experience positive emotions, like happiness, love, or satisfaction?
I haven't really noticed a difficulty with experiencing positive emotions. I'm not sure if that's been an issue for me, as I've been much more focused on the constant anxiety and feeling on edge.
Have these feelings of anxiety and being on guard caused significant difficulties in your daily life, such as at work, school, or in your relationships?

I haven't really thought about how all of this is affecting my daily life or my relationships yet. Honestly, I've just been so focused on dealing with the constant anxiety and trying to feel safe that I haven't really stepped back to look at the bigger picture.
Have these symptoms, like the nightmares, unwanted memories, and feeling on guard, been present almost every day since the event occurred three weeks ago?

Yes, absolutely. Ever since the event happened exactly three weeks ago, I've been dealing with the nightmares, intrusive memories, and feeling on guard almost every single day. It hasn't let up at all since that day.

Even if you haven't stepped back to look at the bigger picture, have you found it harder to carry out normal daily activities, like getting your work done, doing chores, or interacting with family and friends?

I'm not quite sure, as I haven't really thought about how it affects my daily chores or interactions with others. My main focus has just been trying to cope with the constant alertness and those distressing memories every day.
